description: CALL THIS FIRST for any question about a NAMED THING — everything the index knows about it, in one call. It takes ANY subject the index holds, not just functions: a function, a variable (including a function pointer), a macro, a class/struct, a lock, a requirement id, a thread, or a Kconfig symbol. `subject_kind` on the reply says which resolved, and `also` names the other kinds that same name resolves to.

THE PAYLOAD IS SHAPED BY THE KIND, and a field that does not apply is ABSENT rather than empty. A function carries signature, file/lines, brief, liveness, threads, terminus, requirements + covering tests, callers/callees, writes/reads, `body` (verbatim, cut at `max_body_lines`, default 120 — re-ask higher when `truncated`; `anchor_mismatch: true` means the file has changed since the index was built and these lines are no longer the named function's, so refresh rather than trusting them), `sections`, `locks_held` and `external_callees` (call sites not resolvable to an indexed function, which is why `callees` can legitimately be empty). A variable carries its type and every declaration `site` with the source line — which is where a function pointer's binding is written — and has NO body, callers or callees, because a variable has none. A lock carries its identity row and every critical section under it; a requirement its implementers and tests; a class its members and hierarchy.

PASS A LIST WHEN YOU WANT SEVERAL — `subject: ["a", "b", "c"]` returns one entry per name, in order, in ONE call, and the names may be of different kinds. Do this instead of calling once per symbol. Up to 8; more is refused, not truncated. They share one response budget, so a large fan-out may be trimmed — `_limited` then names which symbol lost which panel. `qualified` applies to a single name only.

`depth` GOES FURTHER THAN ADJACENCY. Depth 1 (the default) is the subject and its immediate neighbours. Depth 2-6 additionally returns `chain`, a bounded causal walk across call and shared-key edges — set `direction` to 'forward' (downstream) or 'backward' (upstream) and `max_neighbors` to bound the fan-out. Only a function is an endpoint of those edges, so a deeper walk on any other kind returns `depth_note` saying so instead of pretending.
`kind=` restricts resolution when one name is two things. It FILTERS: asking for a kind the name is not returns not-found rather than the other kind relabelled.
